cues.text: A hospital corridor, outside the closed door of a patient's room.
Inside the room, Chidori sits up in bed. A doctor in a white coat stands at her bedside, by a vase of sunflowers. Junpei, Mitsuru and you walk in and stop at the foot of the bed.
You and Mitsuru leave Junpei at Chidori's bedside and walk over to the closed door.
